messages:
Priya S: quick sync on the PM follow-up for INF-6012 — noticed a recurring eviction cascade during long-tail inference (Wed 02:30 PST). we should move remaining actions into owners+handoff flow. who can take infra changes vs docs/tests?
Evan L: I can pick up the infra side (ttl tuning + pod sizing). i'll need a clear rollback and canary plan.
Mei R: i'll own docs, runbook, and the regression evals. will write the prompt set that caught this and add a playbook step.
Tobias G: i'll be the approver for rollout. put me as A in RACI. Priya, can you be I?
Priya S: yep i'm I. Evan = R (infra exec), Mei = R (runbook/tests), Tobias = A, Priya = I. i'll create a coordination ticket to stitch everything.
Mei R: creating INF-6019 for runbook + evals now and will link INF-6012 in the description. setting acceptance criteria: 1) no eviction >1% across 99.9th tail for 48h canary, 2) alert rate <= baseline + 10%.
Evan L: i'll open INF-6020 for infra changes (autoscaler tune + memory margin). adding estimated effort 4d and a dependency on infra-ops window.
Priya S: INF-6021 will be the owner-transfer checklist (handoff template + revert steps). linking: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6019 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6020 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-6021
OncallBot: heads up: INF-6012 flagged as "postmortem action" and currently in pool. set owners to avoid weekly triage.
Tobias G: we need a canary spec in the ticket — define traffic % and time window, dashboards, and SLO gates. i'll review the canary before approval.
Mei R: adding canary spec to INF-6019: 5% prod traffic for 24h to canary cluster with KV-ttl patch, monitor: cache-evict-rate, p99 latency, mem pressure. will add a Prometheus query & dashboard link.
Evan L: will add an automated rollback rule tied to mem pressure > threshold and cache-evict-rate spike. also adding a feature-flag toggle exposed to oncall.
Priya S: handoff template for INF-6021 (to add to ticket comments):
``
- Owner (during observations): Evan L (infra) & Mei R (docs)
- Canary start: YYYY-MM-DD (planned)
- Canary URL/dashboard: <link>
- Rollback trigger: mem_pressure > 85% OR cache_eviction_rate > baseline*2
- Revert steps: toggle feature-flag -> scale down canary -> rollback infra commit -> notify oncall
- Post-canary signoff: Tobias G (A)
- Oncall handback note: include exact toggle state, commit hash, and what to monitor for 24h
```
Mei R: i've attached the prompt-set and regression harness to INF-6019, added eval thresholds. also created a tiny test that simulates long-tail bursts.
Evan L: assigned INF-6020 to myself, estimated 3d effort after dependency is resolved. pinging infra-ops for a maintenance window.
Tobias G: ok assigned roles look good. i'll mark INF-6020 and INF-6019 as P0 for the schedule and will do the approval review once canary plan is posted.
OncallBot: reminder: triage meeting Thu 08:00 UTC. if owners are set the ticket will not re-enter the pool.
Priya S: summary: owners locked (Evan infra, Mei docs/tests), tickets created INF-6019/6020/6021, canary plan in progress, rollback & handoff template in ticket. timeline: start canary in ~10 business days pending infra window. closing loop here — will ping ops and post final dates.
Evan L: i'll post the exact canary date and the infra slot by EOD tomorrow.
Mei R: i'll finish the runbook and attach the monitoring dashboards. tagging @ops in ticket comments for handoff.
Tobias G: thanks all. i'll check the canary spec when it's up and sign off if gates look good.
